While {a} keeps you occupied with her mouth, {b} trails hot kisses down your neck and trades knowing glances with {a} between every stroke.
{a} pushes {b} back onto the pillows beside you and kisses her deeply, pulling your hands onto both of them at once until the bed is a tangle of bare limbs and flushed skin.
{a} and {b} take turns teasing you right to the brink, laughing softly whenever you try to catch your breath before one of them takes over again.
By the time the candles burn down to stubs, nobody has the energy left to find their clothes; you end up buried under a warm tangle of bare arms, legs, and sleepy sighs until morning.
You lose count of how many times you finish before the room finally goes quiet, with {first} curled against your side and the others sprawled across the quilts around you.
Nobody leaves before dawn. When you finally wake, half the house's pillows are on your floor and nobody looks remotely sorry about it.

orgy_lover._note: A Devoted lady sharing you during a group night ({name}).
_default: Whatever else happens, {name} always ends up back at your side, tucked into the crook of your arm like she belongs there. She does, and she lets the room know it with one sidelong glance.
{name} is generous, laughing, and wonderfully relaxed about the whole affair, but every few minutes her fingers find yours and squeeze—a quiet, private message in a very public night.
At some point {name} whispers "mine" in your ear, so softly that only you can hear. Then she turns back to the others with a bright smile and carries on as though nothing at all had been said.
{name} insists on tucking the blanket around you when the night is over, a small, possessive kindness. "You're coming with me next," she says, and nobody argues.

train_service._note: Hands-on service practice with you (followed by her shown service's private_act line). {name}.
_default: {name} decides your education is a shared project. You work through everything she's comfortable with, one thing at a time, until both of you are confident in the technique. You take notes afterward; she finds this hilarious.

You bring a candle, a notebook, and the serious face you wear for exams. {name} brings a smirk and a very good memory of what she's comfortable with. You run through her repertoire one item at a time, stopping whenever she says "wait, try it like this," and you write it all down.

It's supposed to be a practice session, and for the first ten minutes it very nearly is. {name} corrects your hand placement, you ask a polite follow-up question, and she tells you that politeness is lovely but you can stop checking in every four seconds. The notes get much messier after that.

The practice room smells of lamp oil and warm cedar, and {name} has put cushions everywhere. "Think of it as a rehearsal," she says. You think of it as an exam you're thrilled to be taking, working through each service she's sure of.

You've drawn a small diagram. {name} looks at it for a long, silent moment, tells you it's anatomically ambitious, and sets the pencil aside. After that you do things the hands-on way, and the diagram gets completely forgotten.

beauty: You book {name} an afternoon with a stylist you can't quite afford, then sit in the corner taking notes on skincare.
{name} and you go through posture, grooming, and how to stand in good light while you hold the mirror.
You find a mirror, a comb, and a jar of honeyed pomade, and spend the afternoon on her hair and complexion. She directs the whole thing, and you mostly hold things.
You go through colors in the shop-window light, hold up scarf after scarf, and argue happily about what suits her best. In the end, {name} chooses the one you said was too bold.
charm: You play a string of difficult guests for {name} to win over. Your grumpy dwarf impression is a highlight.
{name} practices small talk on you until you forget it's practice.
{name} and you practice smiling. It sounds easy, and it isn't, and by the end you're both laughing too hard to manage any smile at all. Then she finally gets it right, and it's devastating.
You play a stiff guest and {name} practices melting you. It takes fourteen tries, two bad puns, and a dramatic sigh, and when she finally wins, you applaud.
charisma: You have {name} address an empty common room as if it were packed, then again, louder, from the stairs.
{name} rehearses toasts and introductions while you heckle gently from the back.
You rehearse entering a crowded room, over and over, in the empty lounge. {name} learns to hold a pause and own a doorway, and you stand at the back, clapping with your whole heart.
You make her give a toast to an imaginary room, then another, then a third. By the end, {name} commands the empty chairs, and you're pretty sure they'd follow her anywhere.
refinement: You and {name} work through table settings, forms of address, and which fork is for what. Neither of you is sure about the fish fork.
{name} reads poetry aloud while you correct her pronunciation from a borrowed etiquette book.
A formal tea service appears in the parlor, with all the wrong cups, and you and {name} work through proper etiquette with great solemnity. She corrects your pinky finger. You deserve it.
You work through the finer points: how to fold a napkin, how to pour for a duke, how to look unbothered when something spills. {name} is a natural, and she knows it.
wits: You play a long, fast game of quick comebacks in the lounge, and {name} wins. You write down her best lines for the house's collection.
You quiz {name} on local merchant gossip, noble crests, and how to spot a bluffer at the bar until she's sharper than half the guild.
{name} challenges you to riddles over tea and beats you three rounds straight before offering to teach you the trick.
stamina: You take {name} on a long run along the river. You regret it before she does.
{name} works through a circuit you drew up: stairs, buckets of water, more stairs.
Morning laps around the garden, a stitch in the side, and {name} slowing down to keep pace with you while you wheeze dramatically.
strength: You and {name} haul supply crates up from the cellar until your arms shake and she's barely winded.
{name} practices balance, grip, and pushing back against your weight on the practice mats until she tips you flat onto your back.
agility: You set up footwork drills in the empty parlor, and {name} moves through them with sharp, effortless grace.
{name} practices dodging and quick turns while you toss rolled-up towels at her from across the lounge.

_default: You walk {name} through the trade the hands-on way, {skill} first: posture, pacing, the little things regulars notice.

You pull up a stool, and {name} sits across from you with the focused expression she saves for things she wants to be good at. You work through {skill} slowly, one piece at a time, careful to praise what she does well before mentioning anything else.

The afternoon light slants across the floor while you and {name} drill {skill} together. She tries it, misses, tries again; you offer a small suggestion; and she gets it on the next go with a bright, startled laugh.

"Show me," you say, and {name} does, and then you show her your own clumsy version for contrast. She's helpless with laughter, which is the best thing that could have happened. After that, {skill} goes much more smoothly.

You keep at {skill} until the lamps need trimming. {name} is stubborn and quick, and you're patient, and somewhere in the middle of it she stops looking at you as the boss and starts looking at you as a very good teacher.
service: You and {name} sit across from each other with a pot of tea and a plan: how to greet a guest, how to read a mood, how to make a tired stranger feel like the only person in the room. {name} is quick, and the quiet pride on her face grows every time you say "yes, exactly that."

You play the nervous first-time guest. You are, unfortunately, very convincing. {name} manages to settle you with a few well-chosen words and a warm hand on your sleeve, and then you both realize you've forgotten to keep the act up.
dance: The parlor rug is rolled aside and {name} stands barefoot on the boards while you count the beat aloud. You can't dance, but you can spot where her weight drifts, and you've learned to say so gently. She keeps rolling her eyes and correcting herself anyway.

A phonograph does not exist in this world, so you hum and tap the rhythm on a table, badly. {name} laughs, then takes the beat from you and makes it hers, turning slowly across the floor. By the end of the hour, your humming is the only thing out of tune.
bar: You line up bottles behind the bar while {name} practices pouring, shaking, and keeping a straight face when a regular orders something terrible. She gets the ice rattle just right on her fifth try, and you make her do it six more times to be sure.
You mix a drink badly on purpose so {name} can fix it. She tastes it, winces, and rebuilds it from the base up with a twist of citrus.
combat: "Again from the top," you say, and {name} salutes with a flourish and starts the routine over. Her shadow sweeps long across the wall in the lantern light, and her footwork sharpens every time.

{name} runs the drill again and again, footwork first, then guard, then the long step in. You count for her, and the count keeps time with her breathing. By the end her shirt is damp and her grin is sharp.

You don't know a great deal about fighting, but you know how to pay attention. You watch {name} move, notice where she drops her guard, and say so, apologetically. She tests the notion, finds it true, and gives you a surprised look of real respect.
manage: Ledgers, receipts, and a pot of strong tea cover the office desk. You walk {name} through the weekly accounts one column at a time, and she follows with a finger down the page, frowning, then brightening when the numbers click. "So this is where all the candles go," she says.

"A manager's job," you say, "is to make problems small before they're big." {name} considers this seriously, then asks three sharp questions about the rota that you have to look up. She pretends not to enjoy that.

You role-play a difficult guest. You play the guest, loudly and a bit unfairly, and {name} de-escalates you with a calm voice and a firm smile. You fold in under a minute. She sits back, pleased, and takes the last biscuit.

The window is open to the afternoon, with the noise of the street drifting in, and {name} is working out next week's schedule on a slate. You lean over to point out a clash, and she has already spotted it. "Give me some credit," she says, rubbing it out.

_default: You bring {name} {gift}. She turns it over in her hands and tucks it away somewhere safe.
{name} finds {gift} waiting on her pillow, with a note in your careful handwriting.
You hand {name} {gift} without much ceremony. She smiles anyway.
You give {name} a slim velvet box. Inside is a piece that catches the lamplight. She asks you to fasten it for her.
{name} opens the jeweler's box, closes it, opens it again. "You didn't have to," she says, already wearing it.
A pendant from the Old Town jeweler; {name} holds it up to the lamp and looks at you like you've surprised her.
{name} stares at the box for three full seconds before looking up at you. "Are you trying to bankrupt the house?" She doesn't give it back.
It's far too extravagant, and {name} says so—right after putting it on and checking the mirror twice.

tutor_note._note: Weekly report note when a paid tutor works with her ({name}, {tutor}).
_default: Spent her mornings with the {tutor}.
Her {tutor} left her a stack of exercises. She did most of them.
Lessons with the {tutor} went well this week.

client_yes._note: Fallback highlight when a client got the service he asked for.
_default: They disappeared upstairs for most of the evening, and he came back down flushed, loose-limbed, and thoroughly spent.
He came downstairs an hour later looking dazed and very satisfied.
The door stayed closed a long time; you had to gently steer him toward the exit when he finally emerged.
He left humming a tune from the lounge and walked straight into a lamppost. He apologized to it.
He lingered over his last cup of tea in the lounge, reluctant to let the night end, and asked the doorman which evenings were quietest.
He wrote her a small, terrible poem on a napkin before he left. She kept it.

client_no._note: When a client asked for something not on her menu.
_default: He asked for more than she offers; she turned him down smoothly and kept his coin for the drink.
She drew a polite, firm line at the door, and he accepted it with a rueful shrug.
He tried his luck at the top of the stairs, got a warm smile and a flat no, and went home wiser.
A smooth, profitable shift—regulars asked for her by name and tipped generously.
She kept her guests thoroughly charmed all week and came downstairs glowing.
Not a single complaint all week; two regulars tried to book her for next week before leaving.
A steady, unremarkable week—she did the work cleanly and kept the lamps burning.
Quiet nights and polite guests; nothing went wrong and the coin came in steady.
She paced herself well through a standard rotation of regulars.
A rough week—awkward timing and tired feet left both her and her guests underwhelmed.
She never quite found her rhythm this week, and a couple of guests left early.
Long hours and a bad mood made for a bumpy stretch upstairs.

bad_night._note: Report line after a rough week with unhappy or difficult clients.
_default: {name} had a rough week, dealing with impatient guests and a schedule that refused to cooperate.
A tiring stretch of awkward bookings left {name} ready for a long bath and an early night.
She enjoyed that one.
Her favorite. She was humming afterward.
She came back downstairs smiling.
This was the one she'd have picked from the whole week, and she hummed the entire way back to her room.
She stretched out on the cushions afterward looking wonderfully pleased with herself.

enc_frustrated._note: A finishing service that left her wanting more.
_default: It left her a little frustrated.
She wanted more than he knew how to give.
Not quite what she was hoping for.
She lay awake afterward, staring at the ceiling beams and wishing he'd tried harder.
The evening ended before she'd really gotten started, and she sighed at the door.
She was left drumming her fingers on the windowsill and wondering where it all went.
It was polite, quick, and entirely unsatisfying.
She ended up finishing her wine alone, a little cross.
She drained him dry and came downstairs looking sleek and well-fed.
He barely made it down the stairs afterward; she looked twice as bright.
She actually liked this one, and it showed.
The chemistry was real enough that she lingered after the bell.
He was rough around the edges, and she was glad to see the back of him.
She kept her smile professional until the door shut behind him.

solo._note: A lady alone in her room at high lust.
_default: Restless after close, {name} bolted her door, slipped out of her clothes, and spent a long, breathless hour touching herself in the candlelight until the tension finally broke.
Unable to sleep with her skin burning, {name} locked her bedroom door and worked her own fingers between her thighs until she shivered through a quiet, desperate release into her pillow.
With no one else to take the edge off, {name} drew the curtains, hiked up her nightgown, and brought herself off slowly in the dark.

self_prop._note: A restless lady propositioned a client herself.
_default: {name}, restless, picked out a client herself—and he was not about to say no.
{name} caught a client's eye across the lounge and made the first move.
{name} leaned on the end of the bar, watched the room for a moment, and chose a quiet man in the corner who was clearly too shy to ask. He wasn't shy for long.
Bored of waiting for the bell, {name} wandered through the lounge and made her offer to a client who'd been eyeing the stairs for an hour.
{name} spotted a nervous newcomer fiddling with his sleeves and decided he looked like he needed a kind evening. She asked, and he stammered a yes.
With the fiddler playing something slow, {name} slid onto the arm of a client's chair and made her intentions plain.
{name} had been stealing glances at one particular regular all night, and finally decided to stop pretending otherwise.

step_lead._note: Madame or attendant stepping in for overflow clients ({name}, {role}).
_default: The parlor was full, so {name} set her work as {role} aside and took a guest upstairs herself.
Nobody was free, and a hopeful client was already hovering by the door. {name} didn't have the heart to send him away, whatever her job as {role} said.
You looked harried, the courtesans were all upstairs, and {name} quietly hung up her apron as {role}.
Somebody had to take care of the waiting guests, and {name}, between tasks as {role}, decided that somebody would be her.

stepped_in._note: Summary note when a madame or attendant stepped in ({name}, {n}, {clients}, {did}).
_default: {name} stepped in to cover {clients} when the floor got swamped{did}.
With every courtesan upstairs, {name} personally looked after {clients}{did}.

expect_miss._note: A client expected the attendant to offer, and she didn't.
_default: A client seemed to expect {name} to make an offer. She didn't, and he left a little sour.
A client sat waiting all evening for {name} to make an offer. She never did, and he left muttering about it.
A client hinted and hovered near {name}, plainly hoping for an invitation. She stayed focused on her work, and he left sour.

sample_act._note: Madame sampling a courtesan's technique or promoter giving a free sample ({name}, {act}, {lady}).
_default: {name} pulled a curious passer-by into a doorway near {house} and {lady}, free of charge, then pressed a card into his hand.
Out on the street, {name} gave one hesitant man a free sample: she {lady}, then pointed him at {house}'s door.
{name}'s free sample of the week: a quick {act} in the shadow of {house}'s lanterns.
A guest got handsy with {name}; security stepped in and escorted him out before he could make a scene.
One drunk regular refused to take no from {name} until the bouncer loomed over his shoulder.
One guest didn't want to hear no from {name}. You stepped between them, adjusted your collar, and somehow talked him out the door.
A pushy client met you in the hallway. You held your ground, and the man blinked and went home.
A client got insistent with {name}, and you appeared like a nervous, determined lantern and sent him on his way.
You heard raised voices, hurried upstairs, and put yourself between {name} and the client. It worked, and you needed a sit-down afterward.
A client got pushy with {name}. You stepped in, and it went badly: a loud scene, a bruised ego, and a bad story about {house}.
A client wouldn't take no from {name}. You stepped in with an apology and a tight voice, and the whole thing turned into a shouting match in front of the lounge of {house}.
You tried to talk a pushy client down, but tripped over your own words and a rug. The scene at {house} was loud, humiliating, and everybody saw.
A client got pushy with {name}, and your attempt at diplomacy came out as a squeak. {house} will be hearing about it for a week.
You stepped between {name} and a pushy guest, and the guest laughed at you. It got worse from there, in full view of {house}.
You did your best, but the pushy client shoved past you. {name} had to sort it out, and {house} looked rather foolish.
A client got pushy with {name}. Security couldn't handle him, and someone ran to fetch you.
A client pushed {name} too far, and security couldn't shift him. Somebody sprinted up the stairs to find you.
The guards couldn't talk down the client bothering {name}, so a runner was sent flying for you.
A stubborn client wouldn't let up on {name}. Security held him, and a maid fetched you as fast as her legs would carry her.
Security hit a wall with a pushy client and {name} called for help. Word went round for you.
A very persistent guest kept {name} backed against a corner until security gave up and ran to fetch you.
A client got pushy with {name} and nobody was on watch; she had to handle it herself, and wasn't thrilled about it.
Kept the linens crisp, the lamps trimmed, and the upstairs corridors spotless all week.
Moved quietly through the house changing sheets and airing rooms between guests.
Greeted newcomers at the door with an easy smile and steered the big spenders toward the best tables.
Kept the lounge warm, well-paced, and welcoming from dusk until close.
{name} kept the drinks flowing at {house} and settled two arguments with a single raised eyebrow.
{name} invented a new cocktail this week. Half the regulars love it, the other half are scared of it.
{name} worked the bar all week and knows every regular's order by heart now.
{name} polished glasses until they sparkled and served a gruff old sailor who confessed everything.
Stood watch by the stairs with arms crossed; nobody tried anything stupid within twenty paces.
Kept the floor orderly and walked late guests to the street without a fuss.
Ran the floor like clockwork, matching regulars to the right rooms and keeping everyone on schedule.
Kept the girls steady, the parlor smooth, and the evening receipts tidy.
Drilled the newer staff on poise, conversation, and bedroom technique between shifts.
Spent quiet afternoons coaching the house on polish and confidence.
{name} ran the classroom at {house} with a ruler and endless patience. Notes were taken.
{name} drilled the house until the lesson stuck. Somebody asked for homework. {name} was delighted.
{name} chalked the day's lesson across the slate at {house} and ran the class with a patient, level voice.
{name} corrected posture, vowels, and bad habits with a gentle tap of her pointer. By Friday the house was gliding.
{name} worked the street outside {house} with an easy smile and steered a steady stream of curious newcomers through the door.
{name} charmed merchants and off-duty guards alike along the avenue, sending fresh coin straight into {house}.
{name} worked the evening street outside {house} with free samples and a winning smile, bringing back a steady stream of flushed new regulars.
{name}'s street-side demonstrations drew plenty of attention—and more than a few repeat bookings at {house}.
{name} held the lounge spellbound under the lantern light, leaving half the room ordering another round just to watch her next set.
{name} moved across the floor like smoke and silk, drawing generous tips from every table by the bar.
{name} kept fresh towels, warm water, and quiet discretion moving smoothly between every room upstairs.
{name} anticipated what every courtesan needed before she had to ask, keeping the upstairs floor running effortlessly.
{name} kept the chapel candles lit and offered quiet comfort to weary guests and staff alike.
{name} turned the little sanctuary into the calmest corner of {house}, leaving everyone who stepped inside a little lighter.
{name} tended the bathhouse waters, keeping the steam fragrant and the towels warm all week.
{name} scrubbed, poured, and kept the baths running smoothly from dusk till close.
{name} didn't just scrub backs in the bathhouse this week—she joined a regular in the warm water and made his evening unforgettable.
The steam in the bathhouse got considerably warmer when {name} slipped into the tub beside a lucky guest.
What started as a simple bathhouse scrub turned into several very heated encore sessions in the steam for {name}.
{name} kept the bathhouse busy all week, turning routine soaks into long, breathless private sessions.
Spent a quiet week reading by the hearth and mending ribbons.
Took things easy around the house, sharing tea in the kitchen and resting her feet.
Slept late, soaked in the bath, and recovered her strength.
Took the week off to rest up and eat well.
Took the week off to rest up, soak in the bath, and recover her strength.
Spent a quiet week resting her feet and eating well.
{name} took the week off from shifts, though her restless pacing in the evening made it obvious she was hungry.
Resting from work did nothing to quiet {name}'s demonic appetite—she spent half the week eyeing everyone who walked past her door.
She's been humming around the corridors all week.
Her mood has noticeably lifted.
She's been unusually quiet and a little irritable.
Something has clearly been weighing on her.
She lingers around the office more often now, clearly comfortable in your company.
She's started treating {house} like home.
